name: How can interior home renovations increase property value?

mainEntity.name: How can interior home renovations increase property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior home renovations can significantly increase property value by modernizing outdated spaces, improving functionality, and enhancing aesthetic appeal, which attracts potential buyers. Kitchen and bathroom remodels often yield the highest return on investment. Upgrading energy-efficient features, adding usable square footage, or improving curb appeal also contribute to a higher appraisal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior renovations increase property value by modernizing spaces, improving functionality, enhancing aesthetics, and boosting buyer appeal.
